a) How many unique astronauts are stored in the data set?

```{r}
astronauts_unique <- astronauts[!duplicated(astronauts$name),]
length(astronauts_unique$name)

```

<br>

b) What's the overall share of female astronauts? And what's the share of astronauts with U.S. nationality?

```{r}
share_female <- mean(astronauts_unique$sex == "female", na.rm = TRUE)
share_us <- sum(astronauts_unique$nationality == "U.S.", na.rm = TRUE) / nrow(astronauts_unique)

share_female
share_us
```

<br>

c) Create a new data set `total_hours_df` containing the unique names and the total duration of all missions in hours (`total_hrs_sum`) for each astronaut in the data. Then, visualize the distribution of that variable using an appropriate plot type.

```{r}
total_hours_df <- astronauts %>%
  group_by(name) %>%
  summarise(
    total_hrs_sum = sum(hours_mission))
boxplot(total_hours_df$total_hrs_sum)
plot(density(total_hours_df$total_hrs_sum))
